question: A 40-year-old man is physically and verbally abusive towards his wife and two children. When he was a child, he and his mother were similarly abused by his father. Which of the following psychological defense mechanisms is this man demonstrating?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Experiencing abuse as a child" -> "Psychological trauma" -> "Unresolved emotional issues" -> "Defense mechanism development" -> "Projection" -> 80% CHAIN: "Experiencing abuse as a child" -> "Learned behavior from father" -> "Internalized abusive patterns" -> "Projection" -> 80%
analysis: This man is demonstrating the defense mechanism of Projection, where he unconsciously attributes his own unacceptable thoughts, feelings, or behaviors onto others. In this case, he is projecting his abusive tendencies onto his family members.
